title: EtherCAT Sync SSC/SoE Download
text: Transmit data synchronously to subordinate device represented by service data object, 1 input, 1 output, {Data Type} sets Data type of the IDN; {IDN} sets the identification Number character vector, {Drive Number} sets the index number, {Dimension}, {Network Device Index} sets the etherCAT network identifier, {SubDevice Name} sets the name of device that contains the IDN character, {Sample time} and {Timeout} sets the time to wait for response from subordinate device. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Data
ports.summary: Data to write to subordinate device numeric

ports.name: Error
ports.summary: Report an EtherCAT network error 0 | integer

params.name: Drive Number
params.values: Index number of the drive integer

params.name: Data Type
params.values: Data type of the IDN double (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean

params.name: Dimension
params.values: Dimension of data for this IDN 1 (default)

params.name: SubDevice Name
params.values: Name of device that contains the IDN character vector

params.name: Timeout
params.values: Time to wait for response from subordinate device numeric
